caption: Central Square, Ptolemaida
composition: Circular civic square and municipal building · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the outer sidewalk of the central square in Ptolemaida, a modest municipal building sits in the middle of the circular space, with pines and a ring road around it and low shops beyond. East-southeast morning light falls across the paving under a mainly clear sky, about 13 percent cloud and 11.6°C, with almost no wind. The square is the town’s listed meeting place. No fountain was added, because a fountain appears only in an unbuilt redesign proposal.
